page_title: VEN 0-1 LEC | Venezia v Lecce 25/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' A long pass, executed by Michael Svoboda (Venezia), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
90+1' A pass by Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Mikael Egill Ellertsson and he is replaced by Bjarki Bjarkason (Venezia).
88' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) sends a long ball forward to Ante Rebic, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is behind the touchline and Venezia will take a throw-in.
85' Although Nicola Sansone (Lecce) is just on the bench, Luca Pairetto has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
84' Ylber Ramadani will be replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
83' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Marin Sverko will be replaced by Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia).
83' Substitution. Antonio Raimondo (Venezia) has come on for Joel Pohjanpalo.
82' A corner kick by Venezia is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).

81' John Yeboah (Venezia) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Joel Pohjanpalo, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Venezia are awarded a corner kick.
78' The ball rebounds to Ante Rebic (Lecce) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the left post.
78' Substitution. Hamza Rafia makes his way off the pitch and Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) comes on as his replacement.
77' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to John Yeboah (Venezia).
77' Ante Rebic (Lecce) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just over the bar.
74' Here is a change. Francesco Zampano is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia).
74' The referee allows time for a substitution. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia will be replaced by John Yeboah (Venezia).
74' Golden chance! Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.

70' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Antonino Gallo, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Patrick Dorgu (Lecce), who beats Filip Stankovic with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
67' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
66' Luca Pairetto interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ante Rebic (Lecce).
64' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) is booked.
63' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
62' A crossfield pass from Michael Svoboda (Venezia) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
60' The ratio of the ball possession is 59:41.
56' We are about to witness a subsitution. Gaby Jean (Lecce) for Santiago Pierotti.
56' Marco Giampaolo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ante Rebic (Lecce) replacing Nikola Krstovic.
56' It's a weak and poor shot by Gianluca Busio (Venezia) as he flashes a first-time shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies well wide of the right post.
55' Venezia will take a corner kick.

55' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone reacts superbly to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag and Venezia will take a corner.
53' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
52' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) takes a long-range shot, but his attempt is not a big threat to the goalkeeper.

52' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Wladimiro Falcone, who pulls off a stunning save!
49' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball has crossed the sideline. Lecce are taking a throw-in.
49' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
46' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Luca Pairetto has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
43' Venezia seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

40' What a wasted opportunity by Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Wladimiro Falcone makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
38' Jay Idzes (Venezia) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick into the box and attempts to score with a header. His effort is not accurate enough and bounces away off the bar.
35' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort.
35' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Venezia win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
35' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) passes the ball onto Gianluca Busio, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.

34' Santiago Pierotti sends a terrific cross into the box. Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) gets on the end of it but his header from the centre of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.

30' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
29' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) tries to find Hamza Rafia, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
28' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for an infringement.
26' What a miss! The corner finds Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
25' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

25' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Venezia force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
22' Filip Stankovic leaps to intercept the corner kick from Hamza Rafia (Lecce).
22' A lofted cross from Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. Lecce win a corner kick.
21' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) plays a one-two with Hamza Rafia, but the move breaks down.
19' Flag up against Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
17' Venezia hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
14' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia).
12' Michael Svoboda (Venezia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
9' Michael Svoboda (Venezia) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
8' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) misses a great chance to score after his effort hits the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.

6' A decent save by Wladimiro Falcone. Michael Svoboda (Venezia) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
5' Venezia take a short corner kick.
5' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
5' A quickly taken corner by Venezia.
5' Good defending. Gianluca Busio (Venezia) tries to find Joel Pohjanpalo inside the box, but the pass is cut out. Venezia have a corner.
2' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
2' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Patrick Dorgu (Lecce). Luca Pairetto saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Venezia.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Lecce will take the kick-off.
Luca Pairetto is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
